title: Site hierarchy limits and zone overlap scope
question: How deep can the site hierarchy go, and what relationships are allowed? For "zones must not overlap", which zones are compared (same structure, base structures, across structures)? Does a shared edge count as overlap, and is an overlap blocked or only warned about?
context: Both rules are confirmed in principle (PROJ-REQ-023, PROJ-REQ-024). Neither the limits nor how overlap is enforced is defined.
